text_block_list.text:
One day, Chairwoman Akikawa paid a visit 
to the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
<chrname>'s performance was truly fierce! And 
heroic!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! You have shown a truly wonderful 
performance worthy of being the pride of 
Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I received high praise in person...! It 
seems I've achieved a truly wonderful 
result!
